Quick update from infra diagnostics: the p99 spikes correlate with a kernel dispatch change we rolled out earlier today to improve throughput for long-sequence workloads. Under a particular request pattern (many small concurrent prompts) the new kernel path is causing stalls in KV cache management leading to queuing. Reverting to previous kernel set should restore baseline latency.

I'm kicking an urgent rollback; estimated time to complete: 18 minutes. I'll post logs and flamegraphs to the Drive link when available.

Subject: Postmortem draft: Hosted API p99 regression (Oct 3)

Hi all —

Attached is the customer-facing postmortem draft for the Oct 3 Hosted API latency regression. Highlights:
- Impact window: 16:42–18:26 UTC on 2026-10-03.
- Root cause: rollout of a new kernel dispatch path that regressed KV cache handling under a high-concurrency small-prompt pattern.
- Mitigation: immediate rollback to prior kernel set; rate of errors and latencies normalized within ~10 minutes.
- Action items: tighter canary thresholds for kernel changes, an automated rollback trigger on p99 deviation >20% for 5m, and an SRE runbook update.

Please review for factual accuracy and tone. Once we have sign-off from Exec (Laura -> Markus), we'll publish to the public status page and send the final postmortem to StellarPay with an offer for a one-time invoice credit for impacted volume.

Laura Bennett
Support Lead, Redwood Inference
